page_title: FUL 1-2 CRY | Fulham v Crystal Palace 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Kevin (Fulham) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Crystal Palace.
90+5' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+4' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
90+3' Tom Cairney (Fulham) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle as Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) was too aggressive in his challenge. Fulham earn a free kick.
90+2' Oliver Glasner decides to make a substitution. Yeremy Pino will be replaced by Justin Devenny (Crystal Palace).
90+1' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) serves up a nice cross, but Dean Henderson punches the ball away.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Adama Traore (Fulham) replacing Alex Iwobi.
88' Today's match ends for Harry Wilson who will be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
87' 1 - 2 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 1:2.
87' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

87' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball is out of play. Crystal Palace will have a chance to score from a corner.
87' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) steps up to send the ball in.

86' Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the bottom right corner. Bernd Leno is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.

85' A nice pass finds Harry Wilson (Fulham) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Dean Henderson pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
84' Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
82' Kevin (Fulham) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.
81' Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
81' The game is interrupted. Kevin (Fulham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
78' One of the players from Fulham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jaydee Canvot (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Nathaniel Clyne cannot continue after picking up an injury.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samuel Chukwueze departs the field of play to be replaced by Joshua King (Fulham).
76' Here is a change. Sander Berge is going off and Marco Silva gives the last tactical orders to Sasa Lukic (Fulham).
76' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Samuel Barrott no option but to blow his whistle.
74' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Crystal Palace was in an offside position.
73' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
71' Fulham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
69' Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the right-hand post.
68' A substitution has been made. Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) goes off and Kevin comes on.
67' Samuel Chukwueze (Fulham) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it well wide of the right post.
66' Oliver Glasner prepares a substitution. Jean-Philippe Mateta is replaced by Christantus Uche (Crystal Palace).
65' Here comes a substitution. Eddie Nketiah is given a rest as he is replaced by Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace).

64' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed to the bottom left corner, but it lacks power and Bernd Leno pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
64' Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
63' Harry Wilson (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
62' Crystal Palace enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
61' The percentage of ball possession is – 66:34.
59' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
58' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:5.
57' Neat passing move from Fulham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
55' After what seems an eternity, referee Samuel Barrott decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Fulham, play to continue.
55' Wait! Referee Samuel Barrott has indicated he is going to review the Fulham goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
53' Goal! Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 2:1.
53' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the right post with his header. A stroke of luck for the goalkeeper!
52' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
49' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
48' Kenny Tete (Fulham) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes high over the bar.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Harry Wilson (Fulham) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
44' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace).
41' The Crystal Palace players are exchanging some short passes.

38' 1 - 1 Brilliant finish! Harry Wilson (Fulham) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Raul Jimenez, then produced a nice strike into the left side of the goal. The score is 1:1.
36' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 68:32.

34' Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and produces a low shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
33' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
30' Harry Wilson (Fulham) whips in a cross from the corner, but Dean Henderson is well positioned and punches the ball away.
29' The ball is cleared after Harry Wilson (Fulham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee signals a corner kick to Fulham.
29' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) makes contact with a cross but fails to connect perfectly. His low drive heads straight towards the middle of the goal where the goalkeeper makes a decent save to deny him.
28' A cross into the box from Sander Berge (Fulham) is cleared.
28' The Fulham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Samuel Barrott has a clear sight and sees a foul from Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace).
25' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

24' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Dean Henderson makes a great save to stop his effort. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
22' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
20' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Adam Wharton feeds Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
19' Harry Wilson (Fulham) takes the resultant free kick from distance and swings it into the box, but the goalkeeper climbs high to collect the ball.
17' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno is equal to it and makes an easy save.
14' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
14' Yeremy Pino (Crystal Palace) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man. The linesman points to the corner flag, Crystal Palace are going to take it.
12' Samuel Barrott couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Raul Jimenez (Fulham) and blew his whistle. Crystal Palace have a free kick.
12' The corner from Adam Wharton (Crystal Palace) is hurriedly cleared.
11' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alex Iwobi (Fulham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
10' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
9' Harry Wilson (Fulham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
9' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
8' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) takes the corner.
8' The resulting set piece from Crystal Palace is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Crystal Palace will take a corner kick.
6' Harry Wilson (Fulham) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fulham.
2' Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Samuel Barrott is the one to supervise the game today.
